Dylan: Heads up — noticed a sharp throughput drop on nf4 canaries after enabling aggressive prefetch heuristics, memory on some pods spiked ~2.1x. Rolling back tells us it's related to the prefetch path, not batching config.
Priya: Ugh. Timeline? which pods, region?
Dylan: eu-west-1, pool-gpu-03 and pool-gpu-04. Started at 09:12 UTC. Canary traffic only.
Hao: Any kernel swaps at that time? scheduler logs?
Dylan: Yes, kernel selector switched from fast-4bit-v2 to safe-4bit due to a small quant mismatch, then prefetch ramped up. Logs:
Dylan: ```
2024-06-12T09:12:07Z kernel_selector: chosen=safe-4bit reason=quant-calib-delta(0.08)
2024-06-12T09:12:09Z prefetch: policy=aggressive start_prefetch for model=redwood/nf4-13b
2024-06-12T09:12:21Z mem: rss=18.3G -> 39.1G (evicting=false)
``` 
Priya: That mem jump matches the reported spikes. Did eviction not trigger?
Hao: Looks like KV cache grew because prefetch raced with KV allocation. We saw a KV-latch in the profiler earlier this week — might be the same.
Dylan: Attached profiling snippet from the hot pod:
Dylan: ```
hot path breakdown:
  decode step: 12.3%
  kernel_exec: 44.1%
  kv_alloc: 22.0%  <-- higher than normal
  prefetch_worker: 15.7%  <-- many concurrent workers
lock contention @ kv.c:142 (alloc_lock) 18ms avg
``` 
Priya: So prefetch workers spawn too many concurrent allocations and hold alloc_lock long enough to block kernel scheduling. That would explain throughput drop + mem overshoot.
Hao: Agreed. Quick mitigation: throttle prefetch concurrency per model shard to 1 and add backpressure on kv_alloc. Can we hotpatch a config to the canary?
Dylan: I can push a config change to reduce prefetch_concurrency from 8 -> 1 on those pools. Doing that now.
ops-bot: Deploy started: config/pretech-throttle -> pool-gpu-03, pool-gpu-04 by Dylan (deploy id: d-8347)
Priya: Also we should add a fast path in kv_alloc that returns a preallocated slab when under mem pressure to avoid blocking the kernel scheduler.
Hao: I'll open a tiny PR for a non-blocking fast-path. Will add metrics: kv_alloc_wait_ms and prefetch_workers_active.
Dylan: Rolling back aggressive prefetch on pool-gpu-04 too, just to be safe.
ops-bot: Deploy succeeded: config/pretech-throttle applied to pool-gpu-03, pool-gpu-04 (d-8347) in 45s
Dylan: After throttle, throughput recovered to normal and RSS dropped back to ~20G within 2 minutes.
Priya: Nice. Next steps: Hao will PR fast-path and add gauges; runtime team to run stress with concurrent prefetchers + nf4 kernels to reproduce; ops to keep canary throttled for now.
Hao: On it — PR in a few hours. I'll add a small reproducer script and share perf traces.
Dylan: Thanks all. Filing a short postmortem and linking tracing snapshots.
Priya: :thumbsup:
